MVP (Phases 1–4) is implemented, tested, and verified running. Stopping here for your demonstration as agreed. No extension hooks are registered.

## ✅ MVP delivered — US1 + US2 (Phases 1–4)

**Tasks T001–T027 complete** (27 of 74). Remaining 47 tasks (US3–US12 + polish) are still open and remain the goal.

**Test suite: 24/24 passing** (`npm test`) — search-parser and metadata unit tests, plus save/dedup/edit and search/list integration tests via supertest on an isolated temp database.

**Verified live**: server boots on `0.0.0.0:4000`, saving `https://example.com/` captured the real title ("Example Domain"), and list/search returned it. I then stopped my dev instance and reset the database to a clean **empty state** so the review starts fresh — the broker will start the app itself via `.harness/app.json`.

### What you can try at `http://maker:4000`
- **Save** a bookmark by pasting an address — it captures title/description/icon/preview automatically (when the page is reachable) and defaults to unread.
- **Edit** any bookmark (title, address, description, note, tags); re-saving an address you already have opens the existing one for editing (no duplicate).
- **Search**: plain text (case-insensitive across title/description/note/address), `"exact phrases"`, `#tag`, `budget #work` (text AND tag), `OR` / `NOT` / parentheses, and a quoted `"AND"` treated as literal text.
- **Sort** (newest/oldest/title/updated) and switch the **All / Unread / Archived** views. (Tag management, read/archive toggles, bulk actions, preferences, saved searches, import/export, preservation, and rendered Markdown notes arrive in the P2/P3 stories still to come.)

### One honesty note on scope
To keep the MVP install fast and reliable, `package.json` currently lists only the dependencies the MVP needs (express, better-sqlite3, cheerio, supertest). The heavier ones flagged in T002/T005 (`single-file-cli`, `marked`, `dompurify`, `jsdom`, `playwright@1.61.0`) will be added in the exact phases that introduce them (US11/US12 and the polish e2e task), still pinned as specified.

---

**How would you like to proceed?**
1. **Approve the MVP** after your demo → I continue with `speckit-implement` through US3–US12 + polish to complete the full approved application.
2. **Give feedback** from the demo. Per our SDD conventions I'll route it correctly: a divergence from the approved spec is a fidelity fix (continue implementing to spec), whereas a change to intended behaviour goes back through the spec → plan → tasks before I build it.
